subject: Conditional stipend release and billing path for pilot credits
messages:
From: Sofia Ramirez <sofia@lumenai.com>
To: marcus.lin@redwood.ai
Cc: billing@lumenai.com
Date: 2027-11-09T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Pilot stipend timing and billing path question

Hi Marcus,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team is excited about Redwood's latency profile. Quick question as we finalize internal approvals: the accelerator stipend you mentioned (the $10k pilot credit) — can we get that split across onboarding vs consumption? Our procurement needs clear billing milestones.

Specifically: can 50% be released at onboarding (to cover early dev costs) and the remainder released once we hit either 30 days of continuous usage or $3,000 of consumption, whichever comes first? If there are PO or contract steps we need to take, flag those and share any redlines.

I've attached our projected pilot usage sheet for reference.

Thanks —
Sofia Ramirez
Director of Engineering, LumenAI
sofia@lumenai.com
[Attachment: Pilot_Usage_Sheet.xlsx (spreadsheet)]

From: marcus.lin@redwood.ai
To: Sofia Ramirez <sofia@lumenai.com>
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.ai, kimberly.park@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-11-09T10:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Pilot stipend timing and billing path question

Sofia — really glad the demo landed. Short answer: yes, we can do a conditional split, but we need a small set of acceptance criteria and a PO to lock the sponsor. Proposal below: 

- 50% stipend ($5,000) paid upfront on receipt of PO and onboarding plan (onboarding plan = 1x 60-min kickoff + basic prompt/ingest checklist).
- Remaining 50% ($5,000) released after EITHER (a) 30 calendar days from kickoff with non-zero monthly consumption OR (b) cumulative billed consumption reaches $3,000, whichever occurs first.
- If LumenAI cancels before the second trigger, remaining credit is voided; if cancellation is due to Redwood SLA issues we can negotiate pro-rata refund/credit.

Contract/billing asks: we can put these terms into a short pilot addendum to the MSA. I attached the draft MSA with a couple of redlines that cover stipend timing and billing triggers. Legal will want the PO number and a billing contact (billing@lumenai.com should work).

If that works, please send the PO and I’ll spin up the addendum for signature.

—Marcus Lin
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.ai
[Attachment: Draft_MSA_redlines.pdf (pdf)]

From: marcus.lin@redwood.ai
To: ben.carter@redwood.ai, kimberly.park@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-11-09T11:05:00-08:00
Subject: FW: Pilot stipend timing and billing path question — approval/discount ask

Ben / Kimberly — forwarding Sofia's ask. Ask: can we approve the 50/50 split? Also she asked earlier about an intake discount if they convert after pilot. Thoughts: 10% first-year discount + standard startup credits?

Ben: does finance OK the 50/50 on PO + milestone release? If we need to escrow credits instead of invoicing, flag it.
Kimberly: legal — are redlines in the attached addendum acceptable or will you push back on the SLA carve?

Quick replies appreciated — they want PO by EOD to hit onboarding next week.

Marcus
